item.tib: stong rgyung mthu chen gyis mdzad pa'i brngan bsang chen po'i gzhung
item.coloph: zhes 'dis mchod pa'i brngan yon phul nas/ sa phyogs de ru bkra shis shing / yul phyogs de ru nad yams kyang chad do/ khri srong sde btsan gyis bsam don grub bo/ dge skos lha khang yang tshar/ lha 'dre yongs kyis sdong grogs mdzad/ blon po rnams kyang nad las thar/ btsun mo rnams kyang srid sgo phyes/ 'khor rnams bkra shis bde skyid ldan/ lo legs 'bru smin nad mug sangs/ de ltar bsod nams phun tshogs byung / de phyir las ldan rnal 'byor rnams/ rgyal po'i sku tshe sring ba dang / blon po'i blo rtsal ldan pa dang / btsun mo'i chab srid 'dzoms pa dang / rgyal blon mnga' thang che ba rnams dang / 'khor 'bangs bkra shis ldan pa dang / bod khams bde skyid 'byung ba dang / mtha' dmag dpung chen zlog pa dang / dge skos gsas khang bzhengs pa dang / mchod rten sku 'bum bzhengs pa dang*/ zhing rmo 'bru gzugs byed pa dang*/ char 'beb thog ser zlog pa dang / shi kha yams kha gcod pa dang / ya ma nag po'i sri gos dang / dam sri chung sri 'dul ba dang / byad kha rbod stong zlog pa dang*/ 'dre rgod ma rung 'dul ba dang / rnal 'byor bstan pa srung 'dod rnams/ gang 'dod thugs la 'jog par mdzod/ de la rgyal po khri srong sde btsan yid rangs te/ skor ba byas shing lha phyag btsal/ ber sreb thog gdugs dbu rgyan dang / gser gyi stag mo sna bdun dang / g.yu sna dgu dang rtsa ma gsum/ slob dpon stong rgyung mthu chen la/ mchod yon phul nas zhus pa'i mdo/ slob dpon mkhas pa chen po lags/ spyir yang 'gro ba sems can la/ phan thog legs par bde skyid byung*/ sgos su rang gis bsam don 'grub/ da rung 'gro ba'i don la mi bzhugs sam/ rgyal blon rnams kyis zhus so/ stong gis gsungs pa/ bdag nyid ni na la rgas/ dun tse ban blon phrag dog rtsang gi bya ba la bcas/ dgongs pa mi khrel ba zhu gsungs nas/ stong rgyung gis yon de bsnams te/ nyi ma'i zer gyi srab mda' la bcibs nas gshegs so// srid pa'i brngan bsang chen mo dgos 'dod kun tshim zhes bya ba 'di/ de dus mdzad nas spel ba'i snod ma rnyed par/ thugs la gab/ phyis su smad khams dben gnas lung / las ldan drung mu ha ras/ slob dpon stong rgyung dngos su mjal dus zhus nas gnang ngo / snod ldan sems dpa' brgyad kyi thu bo/ kyu ra pa 'od zer rgyal mtshan dang rang grol bla ma rgyal mtshan gnyis nas rgyud (brgyud) pa'o/ 'di la tshig mi 'dra ba cung zhig 'dug kyang kyur ra 'od zer rgyal mtshan bka' babs kyi slob bu gtso bor gyur pa/ de ltar mi tshig gis lhad med ces de yang yang rtag zhig (brtags gzhigs) byas par khungs thub pa ru snang*/ slar bdag 'dra dge sbyongs/ bsod nams kyi (kyis) ri sul du sug bris mdzad pa zhal bshus so//
